The decoder interprets entry offsets as signed 16-bit word offsets and reads glyph replacements from `max(0, ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset)` up to `min(numGlyphs, size // 2 - offset)`. These bounds include every glyph whose replacement word is within the substitution table and the subtable, for either sign of offset; the new subtable-specific reader prevents reading into subsequent subtables.
